raw_output: Michael's perception and management of job stress evolved significantly over time. Initially, he felt overwhelmed and isolated due to a new job that wasn't fulfilling, leading to anxiety and physical health issues. He struggled with loneliness, a falling out with a colleague, and financial uncertainty. However, with the support of his supporter, he began to explore new ways to cope, including reconnecting with a hobby (playing guitar), seeking community, and prioritizing self-care. He also learned to set boundaries, manage his anxiety, and ask for help when needed. When he accepted a new job offer closer to home with better pay and flexible hours, he felt hopeful but also anxious, reflecting on past experiences and planning to maintain clearer boundaries and focus on positive relationships. Throughout his journey, Michael demonstrated growth and resilience, acknowledging his limits, and seeking support when needed.
